class.name: AudioStreamPlaybackMIDISequencer
class.brief_description: Plays live, scheduled MIDI messages through an OPL3 synthesizer.
class.description: The [AudioStreamPlayback] type instantiated by [AudioStreamMIDISequencer]. Unlike [AudioStreamPlaybackMIDI], it plays no fixed song — instead it's a live OPL3 synthesizer driven directly through [method note_on], [method note_off], [method controller_change], [method pitch_bend], and the other methods below. Every method takes a [param time] argument: the audio frame (not seconds) at which the message should take effect, in the same units as [member current_time]. A message scheduled before the current frame is discarded and logs an error instead of being applied immediately. Pass [member current_time] as the time to act right away, or a larger value to schedule ahead. [codeblock] var playback := player.get_stream_playback() as AudioStreamPlaybackMIDISequencer playback.note_on(playback.current_time, 0, 60, 100) playback.note_off(playback.current_time + 22050, 0, 60) # Released half a second later, at 44100 Hz. [/codeblock]

method.name: channel_after_touch
method.description: Schedules a channel pressure (aftertouch) message at [param time], applying [param value] to every currently sounding note on [param channel].

method.name: controller_change
method.description: Schedules a MIDI Control Change message at [param time], setting controller number [param controller] to [param value] on [param channel].

method.name: note_after_touch
method.description: Schedules a polyphonic key pressure (aftertouch) message at [param time], applying [param value] to [param note] on [param channel].

method.name: note_off
method.description: Schedules a note off message at [param time], releasing [param note] on [param channel].

method.name: note_on
method.description: Schedules a note on message at [param time], starting [param note] on [param channel] with the given [param velocity].

method.name: panic
method.description: Schedules an all-notes-off, silence-everything command at [param time].

method.name: patch_change
method.description: Schedules a MIDI Program Change message at [param time], switching [param channel] to instrument [param patch].

method.name: pitch_bend
method.description: Schedules a pitch bend message at [param time] on [param channel]. [param value] is the raw 14-bit MIDI pitch bend value, centered at [code]8192[/code].

method.name: reset_state
method.description: Schedules a reset of every MIDI controller's state (pitch bend, modulation, sustain, and so on) at [param time].

members.member: The current playback position, in audio frames. Pass this (or a larger value) as the [code]time[/code] argument to [method note_on] and the other scheduling methods to act now or in the future.
